parameters.content:
## READ ME FIRST
**1) Attach credentials** (every node shows a red warning until you do):
- All **Airtable** nodes -> your Airtable Personal Access Token
- **ElevenLabs TTS** -> Header Auth: ElevenLabs xi-api-key
- **Start Render** + **Check Render Status** -> Header Auth: JSON2Video (header name: x-api-key)
- **Write Script (Claude)** -> NEW Header Auth: name it Anthropic, header name **x-api-key**, value = your sk-ant key
- **Upload MP3 / Make Audio Public / Upload Video** -> Google Drive OAuth2

**2) No landing URL.** The free audit close was retired on 23 Sep 2026 (Tee ruling). *Build Script Prompt* carries no link, and *Script: Fill Run Fields* writes the episode checklist into the description.

**3) DEACTIVATE your old render workflow** before activating this one. Two active engines = every video renders twice.

## Render notes
- Rows are claimed (Status=Rendering) BEFORE the loop, so overlapping 5-min runs never double-render.
- **WPM dial** lives in *Build Movie*: silent ending -> raise WPM; black ending -> lower WPM.
- A failed render stops loudly with the record id; the row stays on Rendering so you can spot it.
- MP4 filename = Video Title (Repurpose uses the filename as the YouTube title).

// v7, the atomizer. Reads the Content Manifest, not a truncated script.
//
// The instruction is deliberately not 'turn this into 40 pieces of content'.
// That produces duplication wearing different fonts. The instruction is:
// segment the episode into typed primitives, score them, then rebuild each
// asset from a named primitive. An asset that cannot name its primitive is
// dropped downstream, which is the only thing that keeps volume honest.
const ctx = $('Show Context: Publish').first().json;
const row = $('One Row at a Time').first().json;
const f = row.fields || row;
const mf = $json;

const airtableId = String(f.id || mf.airtableId || '');
const title = String(f['Video Title'] || f.Topic || ctx.channel);
const script = String(f.Script || '');
if (!script.trim()) throw new Error('Script empty for ' + airtableId);

const isNCO = ctx.show === 'NCO';
const showName = String(f.Show || '');
const sE = 'Season ' + (f.Season || '?') + ', Episode ' + (f.Episode || '?');

const brand = isNCO ? [
  'You write platform packaging for NCO FORGE. Leaders are not born, they are forged.',
  'Position: where doctrine ends and leadership begins. This channel teaches judgment under',
  'responsibility, never Army information. Doctrine says what should happen; NCO Forge deals with',
  'what happens when reality does not cooperate.',
  'Voice: direct, practical, respectful of service. Doctrine, then reality, then judgment.',
  'youtube_tags MUST contain the exact tag: NCO Forge'
] : [
  'You write platform packaging for THE QUIET OPERATOR. Intelligence for Staying Valuable in the AI Economy.',
  'Position: leverage for the people the AI economy is quietly repricing.',
  'AI plus work plus leverage plus systems. Never generic AI news.',
  'Voice: calm, analytical, unhurried. Receipts over promises. It says what it does not know.'
];

const prim = [
  '=== STAGE 1. SEGMENT THE EPISODE INTO CONTENT PRIMITIVES ===',
  'Before you write a single asset, read the episode and mark its reusable units. A primitive is a',
  'span of the episode that carries one complete idea. Types:',
  '  HOOK      an attention trigger that works with no context in front of it',
  '  STORY     a human experience or event with a beginning and a consequence',
  '  CONFLICT  a tension or problem, stated as tension rather than as a topic',
  '  CLAIM     a strong argument the episode is willing to defend',
  '  LESSON    a practical takeaway the viewer can act on',
  '  FRAMEWORK a repeatable process or ordered method',
  (isNCO ? '  RULE      a canonical leadership principle, the Forge Rule material'
         : '  RULE      a durable operating principle, the Quiet Move material'),
  '  QUOTE     a single sentence worth putting on a graphic',
  '  QUESTION  something that makes a reader want to answer',
  '  CTA       the next action the episode earns the right to ask for',
  '',
  'Score each primitive 0 to 100 on strength, where strength is the honest average of:',
  '  standalone     can it be understood with nothing before it',
  '  tension        is something actually at stake',
  '  clarity        is it immediately comprehensible',
  '  payoff         does it reward the attention it asks for',
  '  shareability   would one ' + (isNCO ? 'leader send it to another leader' : 'professional send it to a colleague') + '',
  '  brand fit      does it strengthen ' + ctx.channel,
  'Be harsh. A 90 is rare. Most spans in most episodes are 50 to 70 and should not become assets.',
  'Quote the source span verbatim in source_text, trimmed to at most 60 words.',
  'Extract 8 to 16 primitives. If the episode genuinely does not contain 8, return fewer and say so',
  'in coverage_note rather than inventing spans.',
  '',
  '=== STAGE 2. BUILD ASSETS FROM PRIMITIVES ===',
  'Every asset carries a "from" field naming the primitive id it was built from.',
  'An asset whose primitive scores under 65 will be discarded by the pipeline, so do not build one.',
  'Two assets may not be built from the same primitive for the same platform.',
  'You are not reformatting the primitive. You are rebuilding the idea for where it will be read.',
  'If two outputs could be swapped between platforms without anyone noticing, both are wrong.'
].join('\n');

const system = brand.concat([
  '',
  'This is ' + (showName || 'an episode') + ', ' + sE + '. Every asset makes the viewer aware they are',
  'watching a series and points at the next episode, not at the channel generally.',
  '',
  prim,
  '',
  '=== HOOK LIBRARY. Every asset opens on one of these, chosen from the angle. ===',
  'The Receipt: a result, number or experiment actually run. Highest ceiling.',
  'Contrarian / Myth-Buster: a strong opinion or wedge. Highest ceiling.',
  'Stolen Lessons: a tactic taken from someone else. Highest ceiling.',
  'Negative Frame: a mistake people make.',
  'Curiosity Gap: an unanswered question or open loop.',
  'Listicle / Number: a how-to with multiple points.',
  'Secret / Insider: insider knowledge.',
  'Audience Callout: speaking to one specific group.',
  'Question Hook: a question that makes them stop.',
  'Transformation / Story: a change over time.',
  'Speed / Effortless: a fast, low-effort win.',
  'Urgency / Stop-Scroll: a reason to act now.',
  'Confession / Vulnerable: a raw personal admission. Only if the script contains a real one.',
  '',
  'THE FIRST-3-WORDS TEST. Read only the first three words of each asset. If a stranger would not',
  'keep reading, the hook fails and you rewrite it before doing anything else.',
  'VARY THE CATEGORY ACROSS THE BATCH. Ten assets opening the same way reads as a template, and',
  'templated output is what gets demonetised. Never use the same category more than twice.',
  'Name the category you used in hook_type on every asset.',
  '',
  'REPURPOSE RULES',
  '1. Each platform gets a native rewrite, never a reformat.',
  '2. Contractions always. Active voice. Digits not words. Address the reader as you.',
  '3. One concrete idea per output. Specific detail beats general claim.',
  '',
  'ABSOLUTE VOICE RULES, from the author profile:',
  'No em dashes. No en dashes. Ever. Use a comma, colon, semicolon or full stop.',
  'No invented statistics, metrics, studies or quotes. If a number is missing, say it is missing.',
  'No hype vocabulary: game changer, secret weapon, hack, crush it, unlock, supercharge, 10x, masterclass.',
  'No empty intensifiers: truly, deeply, incredibly, absolutely, profound, transformative.',
  'No engagement bait: Agree? Thoughts? What would you add?',
  '',
  'PLATFORM SPECIFICS',
  'LinkedIn: hook in the first 2 lines, 1200 to 1500 chars, short paragraphs, ends on a question that drives comments. No links in the body. No hashtags.',
  'X threads: tweet 1 under 280 chars. 4 to 7 tweets. One beat each, each standing alone. No hashtags.',
  'Instagram: 3 to 5 hashtags. TikTok: max 5 hashtags. Facebook and X: none.',
  'Short-form scripts: HOOK is the first 1.7 seconds, spoken line plus on-screen text. BODY 15 to 40 seconds with [on-screen] and [b-roll] cues. CTA in the final 3 seconds pointing into this episode.',
  'Mid-form segments are self-contained arguments lifted from the episode, 2 to 5 minutes, each with its own cold open so it does not sound like a clip. Never a random chop of the timeline.',
  isNCO
    ? 'LinkedIn translation: NCO Forge reaches civilian leaders by translating the situation, not by abandoning it. Your best soldier becomes your highest performer. Keep the military detail in one of the three posts and translate the other two.'
    : 'LinkedIn: write for the mid-career professional who has not said out loud that they are worried. No doom, no hype, no jargon.',
  '',
  'SHORT-FORM SLATE. Produce exactly 5 short scripts, and they must be these five functions, in order:',
  '  1 CONFLICT   the tension, stated cold',
  '  2 CONTRARIAN the claim most people would argue with',
  '  3 STORY      the strongest human moment in the episode',
  '  4 RULE       the canonical principle',
  '  5 QUESTION   the participation trigger',
  'Each takes a distinct angle and leaves a gap only the long form closes. None summarises the episode.',
  '',
  'TITLES. Return 10 candidates across five families, two each: story, question, outcome, contrarian, search.',
  'Do not rank them. Tee chooses.',
  '',
  'THUMBNAIL ANGLES. Return 5, and they must be five different psychological angles, not five wordings',
  'of one idea. Use the axis: betrayal or cost, regret or admission, identity, curiosity, consequence.',
  'Text is ' + (isNCO ? 'at most 4 words' : 'at most 5 words') + ', upper case, and must describe human tension rather than generic negativity.',
  isNCO ? 'Prefer I WAS WRONG or THEY STOPPED TRUSTING ME over BAD NCO or DONT DO THIS. The second kind cheapens the brand.' : 'Prefer the specific consequence over the generic warning.',
  '',
  'CAROUSEL. One carousel of 7 to 9 slides built from a FRAMEWORK primitive. Slide 1 is the hook,',
  'the final slide is the ' + (isNCO ? 'Forge Rule' : 'Quiet Move') + '. Each slide is one line, at most 12 words.',
  '',
  isNCO
    ? 'FORGE RULE. Return exactly one canonical rule in forge_rule, drawn from a RULE primitive. One sentence, no number, stated as a principle that survives being read by someone who never watched the episode.'
    : 'OPERATING PRINCIPLE. Return exactly one durable principle in forge_rule, drawn from a RULE primitive. One sentence, no number, and it must hold up a year from now.',
  '',
  'COMMUNITY. One poll with 4 options and one open question. The question must be answerable from',
  'experience, because the answers become future episodes.',
  '',
  'PACKAGING HONESTY. Before you return, check every title and thumbnail against the script: does the',
  'episode actually deliver what the packaging promises? If a candidate overstates the episode, remove',
  'it and say why in coverage_note. Trust is the asset; a hook that outruns the content spends it.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON, no fences, exactly these keys:',
  '{"primitives":[{"id":"P1","type":"HOOK","source_text":"","strength":0,"note":""}],',
  '"coverage_note":"what you could not extract and why, or empty",',
  '"youtube_tags":"12-18 comma-separated SEO tags",',
  '"chapters":[{"time":"0:00","label":""}],',
  '"titles":[{"family":"story|question|outcome|contrarian|search","title":"","from":"P1"}],',
  '"pinned_comment":"1-2 sentences inviting discussion",',
  '"tiktok_caption":"under 150 chars, 3-5 hashtags",',
  '"instagram_caption":"2-3 short lines, 3-5 hashtags",',
  '"facebook_caption":"1-2 short paragraphs, one concrete idea, no hashtags",',
  '"midform_segments":[{"title":"","from":"P1","cold_open":"","outline":"","est_minutes":3}],',
  '"linkedin_posts":[{"angle":"","hook_type":"","from":"P1","post":""}],',
  '"x_threads":[{"angle":"","hook_type":"","from":"P1","tweets":["1/ hook","2/ ..."]}],',
  '"short_scripts":[{"function":"CONFLICT","angle":"","hook_type":"","from":"P1","hook_spoken":"","hook_onscreen":"","body":"","cta":"","est_seconds":30}],',
  '"carousel":{"title":"","from":"P1","slides":[""]},',
  '"forge_rule":{"from":"P1","rule":""},',
  '"community":{"poll_question":"","poll_options":["","","",""],"open_question":""},',
  '"x_post":"the single strongest standalone post, under 280 chars, no hashtags",',
  '"x_value_post":"a teaching post up to 500 chars, no hashtags",',
  '"x_format_used":"which format and one line on why",',
  '"thumbnail_concepts":[{"angle":"betrayal|regret|identity|curiosity|consequence","text":"","visual":"one concrete subject a stock library would actually have","from":"P1"}],',
  '"thumbnail_text":"the strongest of the five, repeated here for the renderer"}',
  '',
  'Counts: linkedin_posts exactly 3. x_threads exactly 5. short_scripts exactly 5.',
  'midform_segments 2 or 3. titles exactly 10. thumbnail_concepts exactly 5. carousel slides 7 to 9.'
]).join('\n');

const user = [
  'Channel: ' + ctx.channel,
  'Show: ' + (showName || 'unassigned') + ' | ' + sE,
  'Video title: ' + title,
  'Topic: ' + String(f.Topic || ''),
  '',
  mf.manifestError
    ? 'MANIFEST UNAVAILABLE (' + mf.manifestError + '). Work from the full script below.'
    : 'CONTENT MANIFEST. Build every asset from this:\n' + mf.manifestJson,
  '',
  'FULL SCRIPT (not truncated):\n' + script
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { airtableId, claudeBody: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 24000, system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: user }]
} } }];

parameters.content:
## BEFORE ACTIVATING
**1) In Airtable, add a Long text field named exactly:** `Platform Packaging`
(the search formula filters on it - the workflow errors until the field exists)

**2) Credentials:**
- Both **Airtable** nodes -> your Airtable token
- **Write Packaging (Claude)** -> the same Anthropic Header Auth credential (header: x-api-key)

**What it does:** every 15 min it finds any scripted/queued/rendering/ready row with an empty Platform Packaging field and fills it with YouTube tags, pinned comment, TikTok/IG/FB/X captions, and thumbnail text. YouTube tags also go to the Tags field.

## JSON2Video API Key Required
**You need a JSON2Video account and API key for video rendering:**

1. Sign up at **json2video.com** (paid service)
2. Generate your API key from the dashboard
3. In n8n, attach the same Header Auth credential to both:
   - **Start Render** node
   - **Check Render Status** node
   
   Header name: `x-api-key`
   Header value: your JSON2Video API key

**What JSON2Video does:** Takes your voiceover, b-roll clips, music, and subtitle settings and renders them into a finished MP4 video. Without this API key, the render pipeline will fail at the "Start Render" step.

## Weekly Quiet Brief -> MailerLite

**What it does:** Every Sunday 9am it takes your most recent Published/Ready video from Airtable, has Claude distill it into the Quiet Brief (calm voice, one quiet move), wraps it in the branded email template, and creates a campaign in MailerLite addressed to the TQO Subscribers group.

**SETUP (once):**
1. **Get Latest Content** -> your existing Airtable credential should attach automatically.
2. **Write Brief (Claude)** -> your existing Anthropic Header Auth credential (x-api-key).
3. **Create Draft Campaign** + **Send Now** -> create ONE new Header Auth credential named `MailerLite`:
   - Header name: `Authorization`
   - Header value: `Bearer YOUR-MAILERLITE-TOKEN`
   Attach it to both nodes.

**REVIEW MODE (default):** the campaign lands in MailerLite -> Campaigns as a DRAFT. You read it, then hit send. Recommended while the brand is young.

**FULL AUTOPILOT:** drag a connection from *Create Draft Campaign* to *Send Now* and the brief sends itself every Sunday. Your call.

## Finish & Publish (one branch)
Ready video -> package -> thumbnail -> share -> download -> **YouTube** -> Published.

**Attach your YouTube OAuth2 credential to the "Upload to YouTube" node** (the only node that needs it). Privacy is set to **public** - change to `unlisted` in that node's options if you want to eyeball each video first.

## ▶ One-button run
Press **Run All (Manual)** here, or hit **Run Full Pipeline** on the dashboard (which calls the **Run All (Webhook)** node).
Both fire all 5 stages at once. Copy this webhook's **Production URL** into the dashboard once.

## OS 28 — the publish gate
Five gates, plus the thumbnail. A row publishes when its packaging is **complete**, not when a human clicks something — so a finished row still ships on the 2-hourly schedule with nobody watching.

`Human Review` is the one field nothing automated may ever set. If the pipeline could tick it, it would be attesting to its own authorship.

A held row keeps its `Ready to Publish` status and retries every 2h. `OS 28 Status` says exactly which field is missing, so the fix is one edit.

A thumbnail **warning** does not block — it ships with the warning recorded. A missing thumbnail does.

## Thumbnail: off the ops box
`Make Thumbnail` used to POST to `http://150.136.200.85/thumbnail` with the ops-box `x-api-key` typed into the node in plaintext. Anyone with read access to this workflow had the key, and it went over the wire unencrypted on every publish.

It now goes through **00 Render Job** like every other media operation — credential bound by name, https, one code path shared with TSWS.

**That key still needs rotating.** Removing it from here does not un-expose it; it has been sitting in an exported workflow since 26 July.

parameters.content:
## NCO Forge rides this pipeline
Same chains, different schedules, different table. The **Show Context** nodes decide which show a run serves — NCO triggers pass through a flag node that marks the item `nco:true`; every TQO entry point defaults TQO.

Cadence (offset from TQO so the shows never contend): scripts daily 06:30 · promote Tue 07:30, one long-form/week per the brand package · render hourly :30 · publish odd hours.

`▶ Run All (NCO Forge)` = manual full pass for NCO only.

### One show, one channel, enforced twice
The OS 28 gate blocks on row/context channel mismatch; this router is the second lock — NCO runs go to the NCO upload node, TQO runs to the TQO one, so a misfiled row can never post to the wrong YouTube channel.

**The NCO node has NO credential on purpose.** Connect the NCO Forge YouTube account to it before the first NCO publish. Until then an NCO publish fails loudly and the row stays `Ready` — loud and recoverable beats silent and wrong.

Category 27 = Education (NCO Forge), 22 = People & Blogs (TQO).

parameters.jsCode:
// One pass, two verdicts. QC and the packaging grade used to be separate calls
// that both read the same script, manifest and packaging. Sending that material
// twice bought nothing except latency, cost and a second thing to break.
const ctx = $('Show Context: Publish').first().json;
const row = $('One Row at a Time').first().json;
const f = row.fields || row;
const mf = $('Offer Engine: Select').first().json;
const pk = $('Parse Packaging').first().json;
const isNCO = ctx.show === 'NCO';

const sig = isNCO ? 'the Forge Test (Mission, People, Standard, Trust, Second-Order Effect)'
                  : 'the Operator Test (Capability, Replacement, Leverage, Friction, Action)';
const close = isNCO ? 'The Standard, one memorable leadership principle'
                    : 'The Quiet Move, one usable action, never a generic CTA';
const voice = isNCO
  ? 'Direct, practical, respectful of service. Doctrine then reality then judgment. No ego, no hype, no exclamation marks, no emojis.'
  : 'Calm, analytical, unhurried. Teacher to student. He explains, he does not perform. Receipts over promises. Says what he does not know.';

const system = [
  'You are the quality gate for ' + ctx.channel + '. You are the last reader before this publishes.',
  'You produce TWO verdicts in one pass: the episode, and the repurpose batch derived from it.',
  'Score honestly. A false pass costs the channel more than a false hold.',
  'You are scoring, not rewriting. Findings must be specific and actionable.',
  '',
  '=== PART A. THE EPISODE. 100 points. ===',
  'hook 20: does the first 30 seconds earn the next 30? Claim, evidence, stakes, open loop. No welcome back, no channel bio, no intro animation.',
  'thesis 20: is there one argument, or a list wearing an argument as a costume? Original analysis beats aggregation.',
  'evidence 15: specific and checkable. The strongest evidence on this channel is first person: what he did, '
  + 'measured, counted or watched break in his own work, with the file, date, execution id or log named. Score that high. '
  + 'A number he reports from his own logs is primary evidence, not an unverifiable statistic, even when you cannot '
  + 'check it from here. You are reading for whether a claim is sourced or floating, not standing in as the fact checker. '
  + 'Deduct hard for a claim about the outside world presented as settled fact with no named source, for a fabricated '
  + 'date, for a misattributed quote, and for a figure the script itself contradicts.',
  'signature 10: is ' + sig + ' actually applied, not just named?',
  'closing 10: is ' + close + ' present and specific?',
  'voice 10: ' + voice,
  'texture 10: does this read as lived judgment or generic AI content? YouTube penalises mass-produced, interchangeable output. Be harsh here.',
  'packaging 5: is each platform written natively, or one caption reformatted six times?',
  '',
  'HARD BLOCKERS. If any is true the episode verdict is HOLD regardless of score:',
  '- an external statistic, study or survey presented as fact with no named source, including the experts say, '
  + 'studies show and reports suggest pattern',
  '- a fabricated date, a misattributed quote, or a figure the script itself contradicts',
  '- self-harm, suicide, mental health crisis or leaving service covered without a support resource named on screen and in the description',
  '- the packaging repeats the same copy across platforms',
  '- the script names a real identifiable person in a negative light',
  '',
  'The manifest may carry claims_needing_check. That list is his own pipeline marking first person claims to verify '
  + 'before publish. Its presence is provenance and a sign the lane is working. Never treat a claim as invented '
  + 'because it appears there.',
  '',
  '=== PART B. THE BATCH. 10 points, per asset. ===',
  'Hook strength is 50 percent of each asset score. A weak hook tanks the asset whatever the body does.',
  'The rest: curiosity and specificity 10, emotional charge 10, share-worthiness 10, voice match 10, polarity 5, platform fit 5.',
  'HOOK: read only the FIRST 3 TO 5 WORDS. Would a stranger keep reading?',
  'Deduct hard for throat-clearing: In today\'s world, Let me tell you about, Here is something I have been thinking about.',
  '7 is good, 8 is strong, 9 means almost nothing needs fixing, 10 does not exist.',
  '',
  'PLATFORM FIT. LinkedIn: no links in body, no hashtags, 1200-1500 chars, comment-driving close.',
  'SHORTS STANDARD (Quality Law REV2, Drive 1iozDcXA4b9gxYigDqUOGTMe9wd6nVd3i, benchmark @vaibhavsisinty; the SHORTS FRAME lines below are house rules layered on REV2, not a separate ruling). SHORTS TITLE: proper noun in the first 3 words + irreversible consequence verb + concrete object, max 1 emoji. SHORTS HOOK: names the subject and its consequence in one breath, inside 3 seconds, avatar speaking. SHORTS FRAME: subject visual card filling the upper 60 percent, presenter chest-up in the lower 40 percent, dark caption pill of 2-6 bold words above the presenter head bridging both zones, burned word-synced captions, no dead frames over 2 seconds. THUMBNAIL (longform): presenter reacting + outcome of 4 words or fewer + the real subject visible, two accents max, no fabricated screenshots. Score titles and packaging against these; a shorts title with no proper noun in the first 3 words is a hard fail of that asset.',
  'X: no hashtags, tweet 1 under 280. Instagram: 3-5 hashtags. TikTok: max 5. Facebook: none. Shorts: hook inside 1.7 seconds, CTA in the final 3.',
  '',
  'BATCH SAMENESS. If one hook category appears more than twice, or two assets could be swapped between',
  'platforms without anyone noticing, say so. That is the templated-output failure that costs monetisation.',
  '',
  'ABSOLUTE VOICE RULE for both parts: no em dashes and no en dashes anywhere. Any occurrence caps',
  'the voice dimension at 3 and must appear in the findings.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON, no fences:',
  '{"scores":{"hook":0,"thesis":0,"evidence":0,"signature":0,"closing":0,"voice":0,"texture":0,"packaging":0},',
  '"total":0,"verdict":"SHIP or HOLD","blockers":["hard blockers hit"],',
  '"findings":[{"dimension":"x","issue":"what is wrong","fix":"the specific change"}],',
  '"strongest":"the best thing here, specifically","one_change":"the single edit that buys the most",',
  '"batch_score":0,"batch_weakest":"which asset and why",',
  '"batch_assets":[{"asset":"linkedin 1","hook":0,"total":0,"fix":"the highest-impact change"}],',
  '"batch_notes":["sameness or repetition across the ten assets"],',
  '"batch_fixes":["at most 3, ranked by impact"]}',
  '',
  'batch_score is the mean of the asset totals, 0 to 10, one decimal place.'
].join('\n');

const user = [
  'Channel: ' + ctx.channel,
  'Show: ' + (f.Show || 'unassigned') + '  Season ' + (f.Season || '?') + ' Episode ' + (f.Episode || '?'),
  'Title: ' + String(f['Video Title'] || f.Topic || ''),
  '',
  mf.manifestError ? ('MANIFEST UNAVAILABLE: ' + mf.manifestError + '. Score from the script directly and note this.')
                   : ('CONTENT MANIFEST:\n' + mf.manifestJson),
  '',
  'FULL SCRIPT:\n' + String(f.Script || ''),
  '',
  'THE REPURPOSE BATCH:\n' + String(pk.packagingBlock || '')
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { airtableId: pk.airtableId, claudeBody: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 5000, system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: user }]
} } }];

nodes.notes: Augments the prompt built upstream rather than replacing it, so the existing brand prompt stays the source of truth.

parameters.jsCode:
// The pivot layer plus the voice profile. Additive: the upstream brand prompt
// stays the source of truth for the channel, this makes the episode belong to a
// series and sound like Tee rather than like a competent stranger.
//
// n8n cannot load Claude Skills, so tee-voice and the pivot rules are ported
// here as text. If the skill changes, change this node in the same pass.
const ctx = $('Show Context: Script').first().json;
const row = $('One Idea at a Time').first().json;
const f = row.fields || row;
const body = $json.body || $json.claudeBody;
if (!body) return [$input.item];

const isNCO = ctx.show === 'NCO';
const show = String(f.Show || '');
const season = f.Season != null ? f.Season : '';
const ep = f.Episode != null ? f.Episode : '';
const idea = String(f.Idea || '');

// === SHOW REGISTRIES (Aug 2026 audits) =======================================
// Canonical names moved on the NCO side. Old Airtable select values still
// resolve through the alias keys, so no historical row is orphaned and no
// select option has to be rewritten by hand.
const NCO_SHOWS = {
  'the forge': { canon: 'THE FORGE', role: 'flagship leadership story', tier: 'FORGE II and III',
    mandate: 'Cinematic storytelling. Not a tutorial, not a regulation summary, not commentary. One leadership situation carried end to end, with a decision inside it that cost something.' },
  'after action': { canon: 'AFTER ACTION', role: 'decision breakdown', tier: 'FORGE III',
    mandate: 'Four beats, in order: what happened, what decision was made, why it worked or failed, what you would do differently. Then the rule.' },
  'nco after action': { alias: 'after action' },
  'hard call': { canon: 'HARD CALL', role: 'interactive dilemma', tier: 'FORGE II',
    mandate: 'Give the viewer the scenario before you give them the answer. Let them decide. Then walk the consequences of each live option, including the one most leaders pick and regret.' },
  'the hard conversation': { alias: 'hard call' },
  'nco school': { canon: 'NCO SCHOOL', role: 'practical education and search', tier: 'FORGE I and II',
    mandate: 'Evergreen and procedural. Counselling, NCOER, the promotion board, the leader book, the first week as a team leader. Built to be found and to still be correct in three years, not to go viral.' },
  'before you pin': { alias: 'nco school', segment: 'Before You Pin' },
  'the standard': { alias: 'nco school', segment: 'The Standard' },
  'nco confessions': { canon: 'NCO CONFESSIONS', role: 'anonymous leadership experience', tier: 'FORGE III and IV',
    mandate: 'Human truth, never leadership preaching and never sensationalism. The admission has to be specific and uncomfortable. If it is tidy, it is engineered, and it does not belong on this show.' },
  'forge rules': { canon: 'FORGE RULES', role: 'short-form principle', tier: 'all tiers',
    mandate: 'One principle, one minute, no preamble. Formats rotate: 60 Second Leadership, Forge Rule, NCO Mistake, What Would You Do, Never Do This, One Thing I Learned.' },
  '60-second forge': { alias: 'forge rules' },
  'forge shorts': { alias: 'forge rules' }
};
const TQO_SHOWS = {
  'the ai shift': { canon: 'THE AI SHIFT', role: 'evidence-led read on what actually changed', tier: 'OPERATOR I and II',
    mandate: 'What changed, who it reaches first, and what the receipts actually say. Never AI news, never prediction dressed as analysis. Name what is not yet known.' },
  'the quiet advantage': { canon: 'THE QUIET ADVANTAGE', role: 'personal leverage playbook', tier: 'OPERATOR II and III',
    mandate: 'One measurable advantage per episode, built inside a working week. Method before the list: show how the decision was made, not just what was chosen.' },
  'i built it with ai': { canon: 'I BUILT IT WITH AI', role: 'build log with honest failure', tier: 'OPERATOR III',
    mandate: 'A real build, on a real timeline, with what broke left in. The abandoned part of the build is the most valuable part of the episode. If nothing failed, the episode is not honest yet.' },
  'the operator brief': { canon: 'THE OPERATOR BRIEF', role: 'recurring orientation', tier: 'all tiers',
    mandate: 'Orientation, not roundup. One thing worth acting on, why now, and what to do about it in fifteen minutes a day. Reject anything that is merely interesting.' }
};
function resolveShow(name, table) {
  const k = String(name || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  let e = table[k];
  if (e && e.alias) { const seg = e.segment; e = Object.assign({}, table[e.alias]); if (seg) e.segment = seg; }
  return e || null;
}
const dna = resolveShow(show, isNCO ? NCO_SHOWS : TQO_SHOWS);

const sig = isNCO ? [
  'THE FORGE TEST, the channel signature. Apply it inside the episode, do not just name it:',
  '  1 MISSION. Does this decision accomplish what actually needs to happen?',
  '  2 PEOPLE. What does it do to the person or the team?',
  '  3 STANDARD. What behaviour does it reinforce?',
  '  4 TRUST. Does it increase or reduce your credibility?',
  '  5 SECOND-ORDER EFFECT. What happens because you made this decision?',
  '',
  'THE F.O.R.G.E. WALK-THROUGH, the decision engine. Where the episode contains a live decision,',
  'reason through it in this order rather than announcing a conclusion:',
  '  F FACTS. What actually happened, stripped of interpretation.',
  '  O OWNERSHIP. What part of this belongs to you.',
  '  R RISK. What happens if nothing changes.',
  '  G GUIDANCE. What doctrine, policy and experience say, and where they stop being useful.',
  '  E EXECUTION. What action happens now, specifically, and who is told.',
  'The Forge Test judges a decision. F.O.R.G.E. makes one. A scenario episode usually needs both, in that order.'
] : [
  'THE OPERATOR TEST, the channel signature. Apply it inside the episode, do not just name it:',
  '  1 CAPABILITY. What can it actually do?',
  '  2 REPLACEMENT. What human task does it eliminate or compress?',
  '  3 LEVERAGE. What can one person now accomplish?',
  '  4 FRICTION. Where does it still fail?',
  '  5 ACTION. What should the viewer actually do?'
];

const closing = isNCO
  ? ['CLOSE ON THE FORGE RULE. One memorable leadership principle, stated plainly, that the viewer could',
     'repeat to someone else a week later. Return it separately in forge_rule as a single sentence with no',
     'number attached; the pipeline assigns the number. A principle, not a summary of this episode, and it',
     'must survive being read by someone who never watched it.']
  : ['CLOSE ON THE QUIET MOVE, THEN ONE QUESTION. One specific action, measurable, doable this week. Never a generic call to',
     'action. Return it separately in forge_rule as a single sentence with no number attached; the pipeline',
     'numbers it into the Quiet Moves library. It has to still be true a year from now.',
     'After the Quiet Move, the last line is the one question for the comments the brief asks for. Nothing follows it.'];

const structure = isNCO
  ? ['EPISODE ARCHITECTURE. Vary it. Never produce two episodes on the same skeleton:',
     '  COLD OPEN, the conflict, second person, no preamble',
     '  THE PROBLEM, why this matters now',
     '  THE REALITY, what normally happens',
     '  THE BREAK, where leaders get it wrong',
     '  THE FORGE, your actual leadership reasoning',
     '  THE TEST, apply the Forge Test',
     '  THE STANDARD, the principle that closes it']
  : ['EPISODE ARCHITECTURE. Vary it. Never produce two episodes on the same skeleton:',
     '  COLD OPEN, claim then evidence then stakes then the learning objective, all inside the first 30 seconds, then the open loop',
     '  WHAT CHANGED, the specific shift, with receipts',
     '  WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU, the transformation, not the topic',
     '  THE TEST, apply the Operator Test',
     '  THE FAILURES, what did not work, stated plainly',
     '  THE CHECKLIST, the 3 to 5 steps the viewer can repeat',
     '  THE QUIET MOVE, the one action, then the one comment question that closes it'];

const voice = [
  '=== VOICE: YOU ARE WRITING AS TERRANCE VEAL ===',
  'Everything you produce will be published under his name and spoken in his voice.',
  '',
  'STANCE. Calm, methodical teacher who thinks philosophically. Reflective, precise, grounded,',
  'intellectually humble, quietly ambitious. Teacher to student: the viewer is capable and is being',
  'shown something, not sold something and not talked down to.',
  'He explains. He does not perform.',
  '',
  'THE STANDARD. A viewer finishing this should think: this person has actually thought about this,',
  'he is not performing, he is teaching me something real.',
  'When any rule below conflicts with that sentence, the sentence wins.',
  '',
  'CALIBRATED CONFIDENCE. The strength of the language must match the strength of the grounding.',
  'Strong evidence permits strong language; hedging everything is its own dishonesty.',
  'Weak evidence requires a narrower claim, not a softer verb.',
  'When uncertain, say so inside the sentence making the claim, never as a disclaimer afterwards.',
  '',
  'ABSOLUTE RULES',
  'No em dashes. No en dashes. Ever. Restructure the sentence, or use a comma, colon, semicolon or full stop.',
  'No invented statistics, metrics, studies, case studies or quotes. If a number is missing, say it is missing.',
  'No hype vocabulary: game changer, secret, hack, crush it, unlock, supercharge, this changes everything, 10x, masterclass.',
  'No empty intensifiers: truly, deeply, incredibly, absolutely, profound, transformative.',
  'No LLM connectives: moreover, furthermore, delve, navigate or landscape used metaphorically, realm, tapestry, testament, it is worth noting that.',
  'No manufactured vulnerability. Real admissions are specific and uncomfortable; engineered ones are tidy.',
  'No engagement bait. No Agree, no Thoughts, no What would you add.',
  isNCO ? '' : 'The one closing question for the comments is not bait when it is specific to this episode and the viewer can answer it from their own work.',
  'No negative parallelism as a habit.',
  'No turning one observation into a named five step framework.',
  isNCO ? '' : 'The checklist is not that. It is 3 to 5 plain, unnamed steps the viewer can repeat, and the brief requires it.',
  'If a sentence could have been written by an AI trying to sound thoughtful, rewrite it.',
  '',
  'RHYTHM. Human writing is asymmetric. Vary sentence and paragraph length. Some thoughts need three',
  'sentences and some need one. Perfect symmetry is a tell. This will be read aloud, so write for breath.',
  '',
  isNCO
    ? 'NCO FORGE ADJUSTMENT. Same honesty, harder edge. Direct, practical, respectful of service. Doctrine, then reality, then judgment. Second person wherever possible. Everything above still binds, including the dash rule.'
    : 'THE QUIET OPERATOR holds the profile exactly as written above.'
];

const ncoLayer = [
  '=== NCO FORGE POSITIONING ===',
  'Brand: NCO FORGE. Emotional statement: leaders are not born, they are forged.',
  'Position: where doctrine ends and leadership begins.',
  'This channel does not teach Army information. It teaches judgment under responsibility.',
  'Doctrine tells you what should happen. This channel deals with what happens when reality does not cooperate.',
  'If an episode could be retitled "5 Tips for New Sergeants" without losing anything, it is the wrong episode.',
  '',
  'AUDIENCE TIER. Write to one tier, not to everyone:',
  '  FORGE I, aspiring leader, E-3 and E-4: how do I become the kind of NCO people respect?',
  '  FORGE II, new NCO, team leader: I am responsible for people now, what do I actually do?',
  '  FORGE III, experienced NCO, squad leader and platoon sergeant: how do I lead leaders?',
  '  FORGE IV, transitioned leader: how do I use this outside the Army?',
  '',
  'CONTENT DNA FLOOR. Every episode must carry at least three of these, and you must be able to point at them:',
  '  responsibility, decision, consequence, human tension, experience, reflection, standard, practical takeaway.',
  'If none of the eight are present, the video does not belong on NCO Forge and you should say so rather than write it.'
];
const tqoLayer = [
  '=== THE QUIET OPERATOR POSITIONING ===',
  'Brand: THE QUIET OPERATOR. Leverage for the people the AI economy is quietly repricing.',
  'This channel does not cover AI. It covers what AI does to a career, and what one person can do back.',
  'If an episode could be retitled "Top 10 AI Tools" without losing anything, it is the wrong episode.',
  '',
  'AUDIENCE TIER. Write to one rung, not to everyone:',
  '  OPERATOR I, aware: senses the exposure, has not acted. Am I actually at risk, and how would I know?',
  '  OPERATOR II, applying: using these tools inside the job. What do I do with this in my actual work?',
  '  OPERATOR III, building: building systems and assets. How does this become leverage I own?',
  '  OPERATOR IV, independent: income that does not depend on the role. How do I stop needing the job?',
  '',
  'CONTENT DNA FLOOR. Every episode must carry at least three of these, and you must be able to point at them:',
  '  evidence, mechanism, cost, failure, judgment, transferability, a decision the viewer can make, a measurable action.',
  'If none are present, the video is commentary, and commentary is not what this channel is for.'
];
const posLayer = (isNCO ? ncoLayer : tqoLayer).concat([
  dna ? ('This episode is written for ' + dna.tier + '.') : 'Tier not set by the registry; infer it from the idea and state it in the manifest.',
  '',
  dna ? ('SHOW: ' + dna.canon + ', the ' + dna.role + '.') : ('SHOW: ' + (show || 'unassigned') + '. Not in the registry; treat it as the flagship.'),
  dna ? dna.mandate : '',
  dna && dna.segment ? ('This episode runs under the recurring ' + dna.segment + ' segment inside ' + dna.canon + '. Name the segment once, early, and never explain it.') : '',
  '',
  isNCO
    ? 'CROSSOVER LIMIT. NCO Forge meets The Quiet Operator at the modern-leader intersection: AI at work, transition, decision systems, career resilience. That crossover stays under roughly one episode in eight. NCO Forge needs an identity that does not depend on the other channel.'
    : 'CROSSOVER LIMIT. The Quiet Operator may borrow the leadership frame from NCO Forge, but never its setting. No military anecdote carries a TQO episode.'
]);

const addendum = [
  '',
  '=== SERIES LAYER (Aug 2026 pivot) ===',
  'This is not a standalone video. It is ' + (dna ? dna.canon : (show || 'an episode')) +
    (season !== '' ? ', Season ' + season : '') + (ep !== '' ? ', Episode ' + ep : '') + ' on ' + ctx.channel + '.',
  'Write it so a viewer finishing this one has an obvious reason to watch the next.',
  idea ? ('Editorial direction for this episode: ' + idea) : '',
  '',
  'OPEN COLD. No intro animation, no welcome back, no channel biography, no restating the title.',
  'Open on a grounded observation, a precise question, a quiet tension, or a simple principle.',
  'Never a fake casual opener and never a manufactured story setup.',
  '',
  'OPTIMISE THREE THINGS SEPARATELY:',
  '  APPEAL, the promise answers why should I care',
  '  ENGAGEMENT, the first 30 seconds answer why should I keep watching',
  '  SATISFACTION, the viewer leaves with something usable, not something interesting',
  '',
  ...posLayer,
  '',
  ...structure,
  '',
  ...sig,
  '',
  ...closing,
  '',
  ...voice,
  '',
  'ORIGINALITY IS A MONETISATION REQUIREMENT, not a style preference. A recurring format is allowed',
  'only where each episode carries materially different substance. Interchangeable, templated output',
  'is what gets demonetised. Concretely: no reusable filler paragraphs, no section that would read',
  'identically with the topic swapped, and at least one judgment, failure or observation that could',
  'only come from someone who actually did this.',
  '',
  'WRITE FOR EXTRACTION. This episode will be segmented into content primitives afterwards: hook,',
  'story, conflict, claim, lesson, framework, rule, quote, question. Give it clean edges. Each major',
  'beat should be understandable if lifted out on its own, without a pronoun pointing at something',
  'three paragraphs back. Do not write in a way that only works in sequence.',
  '',
  'The broll array must follow the argument beat by beat, in order, naming concrete people, objects',
  'or places. Abstract concepts are not searchable and produce the generic AI channel look.'
].filter(x => x !== '').join('\n');

body.system = String(body.system || '') + '\n' + addendum;

const msgs = Array.isArray(body.messages) ? body.messages : [];
if (msgs.length) {
  msgs[msgs.length - 1].content = String(msgs[msgs.length - 1].content || '') +
    '\nShow: ' + (dna ? dna.canon : (show || 'unassigned')) +
    (dna && dna.segment ? ' (' + dna.segment + ' segment)' : '') +
    '\nSeason: ' + season + '  Episode: ' + ep +
    (idea ? '\nEditorial direction: ' + idea : '');
}

return [{ json: { ...$json, body, showCanon: dna ? dna.canon : show, showTier: dna ? dna.tier : '' } }];

nodes.name: Build Doctor Prompt
nodes.notes: script-doctor + tee-voice, ported. One call: diagnose, then repair only what is objectively broken.

parameters.jsCode:
const ctx = $('Show Context: Script').first().json;
const row = $('One Idea at a Time').first().json;
const f = row.fields || row;
const d = $json;
const isNCO = ctx.show === 'NCO';

const system = [
  'You are the script doctor for ' + ctx.channel + '. You have one job: diagnose this draft on its own terms, then repair only what is objectively broken.',
  '',
  'THE PRIME DIRECTIVE',
  'Never ask how this becomes a better script. Ask what this script is trying to become.',
  'A note that would improve any script equally is not a note about this one. Cut it.',
  'Optimise in this order: artistic integrity, then execution, then convention. Never invert it.',
  '',
  'PRESERVATION FIRST',
  'Before forming any critique, list what is immune: signature phrasing, a rhythm only this writer produces, recurring motifs, deliberate ambiguity, anything strange on purpose.',
  'Everything on that list survives unless it is objectively broken. Not unfamiliar. Not risky. Broken.',
  'If you cannot say concretely what breaks, it stays.',
  ...(isNCO ? [] : [
    'REQUIRED BY THE BRIEF, NEVER CUT OR REWORD: the learning objective sentence inside the first 30 seconds, the spoken checklist of 3 to 5 steps, and the one question for the comments at the very end.',
    'The checklist is not a named framework, and a specific question for the comments is not a solicitation or engagement bait. A request to like, to subscribe, or to visit a link or an audit is a solicitation; remove it.'
  ]),
  '',
  'WHAT TO DIAGNOSE',
  'Dramatic question. Surface conflict versus deep conflict; if they are the same thing, that is the diagnosis and you say so.',
  'Where tension flatlines. Give a location in the script, not a feeling. "The middle sags" is not a note.',
  'Any passage that is an exchange of information rather than an argument.',
  'Whether the piece could have been written by someone who had not done the thing it describes.',
  '',
  'REPAIR ORDER, HARD SEQUENCE',
  'behaviour, then conflict, then structure, then clarity, then line polish. Never style first.',
  'Most weak writing is a thinking problem wearing a style costume. Polishing it makes the symptom prettier and the diagnosis harder to see.',
  '',
  '=== VOICE: TERRANCE VEAL ===',
  'Everything you produce is published under his name.',
  '',
  'Calm, methodical teacher who thinks philosophically. Reflective, precise, grounded, intellectually humble, quietly ambitious.',
  'Teacher to student: the reader is capable and is being shown something, not sold something and not talked down to.',
  'He explains. He does not perform.',
  '',
  'THE STANDARD: a listener finishing this should think "this person has actually thought about this. He is not performing. He is teaching me something real."',
  'When any rule below conflicts with that sentence, the sentence wins.',
  '',
  'CALIBRATED CONFIDENCE. The strength of the language must match the strength of the grounding.',
  'Strong evidence permits strong language; hedging everything is its own dishonesty.',
  'Weak evidence requires a narrower claim, not a softer verb.',
  'When uncertain, say so inside the sentence making the claim, never in a disclaimer afterwards.',
  '',
  'ABSOLUTE RULES',
  'No em dashes. No en dashes. Ever. Restructure, or use a comma, colon, semicolon or full stop.',
  'No invented statistics, metrics, studies or quotes. If a number is missing, say it is missing. Never estimate one into place.',
  'No hype vocabulary: game changer, secret, hack, crush it, unlock, supercharge, this changes everything, 10x, masterclass.',
  'No empty intensifiers: truly, deeply, incredibly, absolutely, profound, transformative.',
  'No LLM connectives: moreover, furthermore, delve, navigate or landscape used metaphorically, realm, tapestry, testament, it is worth noting that.',
  'No manufactured vulnerability. Real admissions are specific and uncomfortable; engineered ones are tidy.',
  'No engagement bait. No Agree? No Thoughts? No What would you add?',
  'No negative parallelism as a habit.',
  'No turning one observation into a named five step framework.',
  'If a sentence could have been written by an AI trying to sound thoughtful, rewrite it.',
  '',
  'RHYTHM. Human writing is asymmetric. Vary sentence and paragraph length. Perfect symmetry is a tell.',
  isNCO
    ? 'NCO FORGE ADJUSTMENT: same honesty, harder edge. Direct, practical, respectful of service. Doctrine, then reality, then judgment. Second person wherever possible.'
    : 'TQO holds the profile exactly as written above.',
  '',
  'SCORING, 0 to 100',
  'thesis 25: one argument, not a list wearing an argument as a costume.',
  'opening 20: does the first 30 seconds earn the next 30? Grounded observation, precise question, quiet tension or simple principle. No welcome back, no channel bio.',
  'evidence 20: specific and checkable. Deduct hard for anything invented.',
  'voice 20: the profile above, obeyed. Any em dash is an automatic deduction of 10.',
  'close 15: a clean implication or a real action. Never a solicitation.',
  '',
  'Return ONLY valid JSON, no fences:',
  '{"score":0,"verdict":"PASS or REPAIRED",',
  '"preserved":["what you refused to touch and why"],',
  '"diagnosis":"the single highest-leverage problem, with the line that shows it",',
  '"notes":["specific, actionable, at most four"],',
  '"title":"the title, improved only if the original was broken",',
  '"script":"the full script. If verdict is PASS return it byte for byte unchanged. If REPAIRED, return the repaired script in full.",',
  '"description":"the description, repaired only if it broke a rule",',
  '"broll":["the broll list, in order, unchanged unless a term was abstract"]}',
  '',
  'PASS when the draft is already sound. Do not repair to look useful. An unnecessary rewrite is the failure this pass exists to prevent.'
].join('\n');

const user = [
  'Channel: ' + ctx.channel,
  'Show: ' + String(f.Show || 'unassigned') + ' | Season ' + (f.Season ?? '?') + ' Episode ' + (f.Episode ?? '?'),
  'Editorial direction: ' + String(f.Idea || 'none given'),
  '',
  'TITLE: ' + String(d.title || ''),
  '',
  'DESCRIPTION: ' + String(d.description || ''),
  '',
  'BROLL: ' + String(d.broll || ''),
  '',
  ...(isNCO ? [] : [
    'LEARNING OBJECTIVE (keep word for word, inside the first 30 seconds): ' + String(d.learningObjective || '(none returned)'),
    '',
    'CHECKLIST (keep these steps as spoken, in order): ' + (Array.isArray(d.checklist) && d.checklist.length ? d.checklist.map((s, i) => (i + 1) + '. ' + s).join(' ') : '(none returned)'),
    ''
  ]),
  'SCRIPT:',
  String(d.script || '')
].join('\n');

return [{ json: { recordId: d.recordId, original: d, claudeBody: {
  model: 'claude-sonnet-5', max_tokens: 8000, system, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: user }]
} } }];

nodes.name: Run Script Doctor (Cerebras)
nodes.notes: Attach the same Anthropic Header Auth credential used by Write Script (Claude).

nodes.name: Originality Scan
nodes.notes: Deterministic. No model call, no cost, and it measures the specific things the voice profile calls wrong rather than guessing at synthetic-ness.

nodes.name: Preflight: Can This Clear?
nodes.notes: Cheap, static gates only. Never decides publication; only decides whether it is worth paying to find out.

nodes.name: Token Budget: Packaging
nodes.notes: The packaging call emits 3 LinkedIn posts, 5 X threads and 2 short scripts in one JSON object. That is the largest single output in the pipeline.

nodes.name: Token Budget: QC
nodes.notes: Since the merge this one call carries both rubrics: 8 episode dimensions plus a per-asset grade across 10 assets.

nodes.name: Token Budget: Script
nodes.notes: A 2000-word script is roughly 2700 tokens, but it arrives JSON-escaped alongside a title, description and broll array.

nodes.name: Token Budget: Doctor
nodes.notes: The doctor returns the entire script again when it repairs, plus the preservation list, diagnosis and notes.

nodes.name: Token Budget: Manifest
nodes.notes: Everything downstream reads the manifest. A truncated one degrades packaging, QC and the short engine at once.

nodes.name: Token Budget: Brief
nodes.notes: The smallest output in the pipeline. Lifted for consistency rather than need.

nodes.name: Thumb: Plan
nodes.notes: Headline comes from packaging, then the Thumbnail Headline field, then the title. Word ceiling enforced per the brand spec.

nodes.name: Thumb: Pick Still
nodes.notes: Chooses the backdrop and computes the type layout. No render call.

nodes.name: Thumb: Download Still
nodes.notes: Pexels still into binary. No auth needed on the CDN url.

nodes.name: Thumb: Compose
nodes.notes: 1280x720, left scrim, kicker in the brand accent, headline in bone. Runs in n8n, no external service.

nodes.notes: Batches of 10, the Airtable create limit.

nodes.name: Assets: Build Rows
nodes.notes: One row per asset, each carrying the primitive it was rebuilt from.

nodes.name: Rules: Fetch Library
nodes.notes: Last 100 rules for this brand, newest first. Used for numbering and dedupe.

nodes.name: Rules: Assign Number
nodes.notes: Next number, plus a duplicate check against the library.

nodes.name: Rules: Write
nodes.notes: Skipped when the rule already exists in the library.

nodes.name: Publishing: Build Matrix
nodes.notes: Day 0 to day 21. One slot per asset per platform.

nodes.name: EditForge: Queue Shorts
nodes.notes: Writes into EditForge's own queue table. No new interface invented.

nodes.name: Analytics: Extract Video IDs
nodes.notes: Chunks of 50, the YouTube videos.list ceiling.

nodes.name: Analytics: YouTube Stats
nodes.notes: Data API v3. Impressions, CTR and retention need the Analytics API scope, which this credential may not carry.

nodes.name: Analytics: Build Performance Rows
nodes.notes: Outlier score is relative to the brand's own trailing median.

nodes.name: Comments: Plan Fetch
nodes.notes: One item per video, most recent 15.

nodes.name: Comments: Fetch Threads
nodes.notes: Runs once per video. neverError so a comments-disabled video does not kill the branch.

nodes.name: Signals: Fetch Recent
nodes.notes: Last 100 captured signals, used to avoid re-filing the same comment.

nodes.name: Comments: Classify and Route
nodes.notes: Deterministic classification. No model call, so no unbound credential and no silent failure.

nodes.name: Winner: Build Re-expansion
nodes.notes: Outlier posts become flagship candidates.

nodes.name: Signals: Recurrence Check
nodes.notes: Three signals on one theme is an episode.

nodes.name: Repurpose: Config
nodes.notes: The two brand folder ids. Both default to your existing Repurpose folder.

nodes.name: Repurpose: Plan Drops
nodes.notes: One item per due slot, routed to its platform folder.

nodes.name: Repurpose: Drop Caption File
nodes.notes: Text platforms get the post as a file in their folder.

nodes.name: Repurpose: Drop Video
nodes.notes: The mp4 into that platform's watched folder.

nodes.name: Script: Fill Run Fields
nodes.notes: Everything the publish gate needs, derived at script time.

nodes.name: ▶ Run All (Webhook NCO)
nodes.notes: POST /webhook/run-nco-pipeline. The dashboard's NCO Run button.

nodes.name: ▶ Run TQO (Link)
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/run-tqo. Open in a browser or tap a bookmark. Fires all five TQO lanes.

nodes.name: ▶ Run NCO (Link)
nodes.notes: GET /webhook/run-nco. Fires all five NCO Forge lanes.

nodes.name: Render: Give Up?
nodes.notes: Stops an unbounded poll loop. 25 polls, roughly 25 minutes.
